text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One enters the Tenno Sho (Autumn) to 
gain experience on the grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume defining this era will also 
be running. Tamamo Cross, the "White 
Lightning." Oguri Cap, the "Monster."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Faced with the overwhelming presence of 
the two, she resolves to throw herself 
into the festival with everything she has. 
At last, the curtain rises on the race.
